items.title: Vi Redd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: She used to write to me when she became so ill that she was down at Duke University, she used to write to me, and I’d write to her

ctx.x: Well how could we — wasn’t she an unbelievable talent?

She used to write to me when she became so ill that she was down at Duke University, she used to write to me, and I’d write to her, at the time she was quite ill. But I’ll have to come back another time.
